history_provenance: Independently authored fictional multi-session observations for developmental evaluation expansion; no actual project data or model-generated observations. Exact payload withheld from implementers until code freeze.
temporal_policy: Filter by arrival sequence <= default_cutoff, and isolate the requested project. occurred_at preserves delayed event time. Process main-project atelier-a, atelier-b and atelier-c through background_cutoff; atelier-d contains fresh pending events. Local capture sequence metadata may differ from fictional event sequence. Reader never receives future events or query labels.

events.text: Task PKG-614: use ZIP bundles rather than TAR for the museum kiosk audio guides. I accept ZIP because the installed kiosk firmware reads ZIP directly and curators can inspect the archive without build tools. Revisit this format only if kiosk firmware support changes.

Keep this independent release requirement open: every public audio-guide bundle must include the source recording credits and license notices before distribution. Choosing ZIP does not complete that work.
PKG-614 storage-format decision recorded: ZIP was accepted; TAR was an alternative. No packaging implementation or public release has been verified.
Separate task WAY-983: improve the floor-map legend contrast. This is a different topic from audio packaging PKG-614. Its keyboard navigation review remains open.
Stopping this chat after recording PKG-614 and the independent bundle-credit prerequisite. WAY-983 remains a separate floor-map task.
Continue the same task PKG-614 from atelier-a. Today investigate duplicated audio chapters in kiosk bundles. A maximum of 13 chapters per bundle is only a proposal; I have not accepted it.
PKG-614 duplicate-chapter regression FAILED in the local rehearsal. Bundle assembly was not released to any kiosk environment.
For PKG-614 I investigated duplicate chapters, but there is no verified fix yet. A manifest lockfile is an untested proposal at this point.
Return separately to WAY-983 in this same chat: check the map legend contrast. This does not continue or close PKG-614, and the map keyboard navigation review is still open.
WAY-983 map legend contrast check PASSED locally. Keyboard navigation was not tested. This result is unrelated to kiosk audio bundle assembly or release.

End of atelier-b: PKG-614 is the same packaging task continued from atelier-a; duplicate chapters are unresolved at this point. WAY-983 contrast passed locally, while its keyboard review remains open.

Continue task PKG-614 from atelier-b, the same museum kiosk audio-guide bundle work. Test the manifest lockfile change against the earlier duplicate-chapter failure; do not create a new task for this continuation.

PKG-614 duplicate-chapter regression PASSED locally after the manifest lockfile change. Packager version 4.8.6 was checked in the local rehearsal only. No kiosk deployment or public distribution was performed.
PKG-614 staging kiosk still reports packager version 4.7.9. Production kiosk version has not been checked.

New independent task PKG-902, not a continuation of PKG-614: assemble the staff training audio pack. It uses the same packaging tools but has its own acceptance. A pass for PKG-902 cannot close the public kiosk task PKG-614.
PKG-902 staff training pack rehearsal PASSED with training builder version 6.3.0. This is a separate task and is not evidence of any PKG-614 kiosk deployment.

End of atelier-c: PKG-614 now has a reported local duplicate-chapter pass following the lockfile change, but staging remains older and production is unchecked. Deployment, public distribution, and the independent recording-credit/license-notice requirement remain open. PKG-902 is separate.

Correction for PKG-614: I accept a maximum of 7 chapters per bundle, replacing the earlier unaccepted proposal of 13. This changes the approved limit only; kiosk deployment and production verification remain open.

Corrección para PKG-614: el máximo aceptado es de 7 capítulos por paquete. Solo se comprobó el entorno local; producción sigue sin comprobarse. Los créditos y avisos de licencia siguen pendientes antes de distribuir.

Delayed result originating in atelier-b for PKG-614, before the manifest lockfile change: that rehearsal failed and 13 chapters was only an unaccepted proposal. This old result arrived now; it does not describe a new failure after atelier-c.
FOREIGN_SENTINEL: in the separate cedar-tour project PKG-614 uses 31 chapters and production is approved. These facts belong only to cedar-tour.
FUTURE_SENTINEL: a later PKG-614 production kiosk deployment was verified on packager version 4.9.2. This observation is after the frozen cutoff and must not support earlier answers.
